channel.title: Wildcard Watch: VMware

item.title: Patch now: VMware vCenter Server: vCenter authentication-bypass
item.description:
VMware vCenter Server: exploited from day 0 (news only) · fix: 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300, 8.0 U3m

First step: Update VMware vCenter Server to the fixed version for your release line (for example 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300 or 8.0 U3m).

VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-123903
